subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To go through an area making a lot of noise and causing damage
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rampage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Rampage"** means to go through an area making a lot of noise and causing damage. (उपद्रव करना)

 

 
• **Example: **The angry mob went on a rampage, breaking windows and setting cars on fire.

 

 

 
• **"Brutality"** refers to savage physical violence; great cruelty. (क्रूरता)

 

 
• **Example: **The brutality of the attack shocked the entire community.

 

 

 
• **"Cacophony"** is a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds. (कर्कश ध्वनि)

 

 
• **Example: **The cacophony of horns honking and people shouting made it hard to concentrate.

 

 

 
• **"Violence"** involves behavior involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something. (हिंसा)

 

 
• **Example: **There was a lot of violence during the protest.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Rampage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Brutality** (क्रूरता): Savage physical violence; great cruelty.

 

 
• **Example:** The brutality of the dictator was feared by all.

 

 

 
• **Cacophony** (कर्कश ध्वनि): A harsh, discordant mixture of sounds.

 

 
• **Example:** The cacophony of the city was overwhelming to the countryside visitors.

 

 

 
• **Violence** (हिंसा): Behavior involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.

 

 
• **Example:** The violence in the movie was disturbing.
